basics.label: Software Developer · DevOps, Docker, PostgreSQL
basics.summary: Developer with more than 12 years of experience who also owns how software gets to production: building and publishing Docker images, deploying to Linux servers over SSH, running production PostgreSQL, and automating builds with GitHub Actions. I care about systems that are maintainable and reliable.

highlights: Handle DevOps: Docker images are built locally, published to Docker Hub, and deployed over SSH by pulling the new image and restarting the containers.
Manage production PostgreSQL databases and the single production VPS.

Designed and built a new application architecture to replace a legacy system with significant technical debt. Rebuilt rather than patched, because the architectural problems could not be fixed incrementally.
Built and maintained Elixir/Phoenix microservices that consumed operations queued through Kafka and communicated with a Ruby on Rails monolith.
Validated and tested the warehouse operations interface, which ran 24/7.
Followed a team process requiring a dedicated pull request with detailed explanations and diagrams for every database migration, and wrote RFCs for large or controversial features.
Improved security by hashing sensitive values and adding magic-link login.
Re-architected the Stripe payments integration with simplified webhooks, the Stripe Customer Portal, and customized forms across all products.
Worked with the DevOps engineer to set up a Kubernetes rolling-update deployment for a high-demand application, so new releases went out without downtime.
Built an integration with a CRM using the WhatsApp API, running local proxy containers that connected to a MySQL service on Google Cloud.
Contributed open-source Elixir libraries: wax and rfc_facil.
Led the redesign and maintenance of the Clarovideo streaming app for Android mobile and set-top boxes.
Managed six developers by delegating tickets and providing technical guidance.
Reviewed and fixed issues in the Go script that synchronized merchandise from the back office to the e-commerce storefront.
